title: Las ideas neoliberales
goal: Read how the 1989 Washington Consensus formalized ten market-reform prescriptions that most 1990s Latin American governments adopted after the lost decade, building on Chile's earlier Chicago Boys precedent.

items: State who coined "Consenso de Washington" and when.
List some of the ten recommendations it included.
Explain why many governments adopted these ideas in the 1990s.
Explain Chile's role as an earlier precedent.
Use en pos de to name a pursued goal.
